purpose: Teach: 尺度/原題/考案/多種/年版/義務づけ/失格/事業主

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、創業期、自分の尺度で人を見られたぞ
lines.en: Dad had his own way of measuring people right from the founding.
lines.style: Warm, deliberate recall. Eyes slightly distant. Measured pace—each phrase lands like a placed stone. Quiet pride underneath. Voice trails softly, inviting the son to understand without explaining.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは商品の原題決定にこだわられた
lines.en: Yes. Father was very particular about the product's original naming.
lines.style: Respectful, almost ceremonial nod to the memory. Measured, attentive. Slight pause before speaking—choosing words carefully, honoring the subject. Steady eye contact with the elder, receiving the lesson.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、独自の販売法を考案されたぞ
lines.en: Dad created his own approach to sales that no one else had thought of.
lines.style: Gentle, almost marveling tone. Slower pace. Breath of admiration threaded through. Voice softens on the tail, like turning a valued object over in one's hands.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは多種の業界に通じておられた
lines.en: Yes. Father had deep knowledge across many different industries.
lines.style: Thoughtful, validating. Slight pause before answering, as if seeing the full picture. Calm, measured delivery. Not lecturing—witnessing aloud what the father built.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、年版の社員手帳をご準備された
lines.en: Dad made sure to prepare an updated staff handbook every year.
lines.style: Quiet admiration in the voice. Slower, deliberate pacing. Each detail weighted with care. Slight exhale—the small, meticulous choices that built something lasting.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは社員研修を義務づける制度を作られた
lines.en: Yes. Father created a system that made employee training mandatory for everyone.
lines.style: Respectful reflection. Steady, measured pace. Each phrase careful and deliberate, honoring the scope of what was built. Calm certainty—not boasting, but acknowledging vision.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、不正は即失格と厳しかった
lines.en: Dad was strict—fraud meant immediate dismissal, no exceptions.
lines.style: Quieter now, weight of principle in the voice. Slower pace. Gravity settles in—this is the harder part of respect. Voice stays level, firm but not harsh. The courage to hold a line.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは事業主としての覚悟をお持ちでした
lines.en: Yes. Father carried the resolve of a true business owner, all the way through.
lines.style: Steady, final. This is the summation—voice carries both weight and closure. Soft but firm. Deep respect, no performance. The tail trails into silence, leaving the lesson complete.
